The Bombay High Court Peon Result 2026 has been released on 1st September for candidates who appeared in the Screening/Written Test held for the recruitment process. The High Court has shortlisted 5,517 candidates for the Principal Seat at Bombay and 1,378 candidates for the Nagpur Bench for the next stage. The shortlisted candidates will appear for the Physical Fitness and Special Skill Test. Earlier the Court released the Bombay High Court Clerk result on 8th July on its official website at bombayhighcourt.nic.in. Candidates can check their result PDF, shortlist details, cut off marks and more in this article.

Bombay High Court Peon Result 2026

The Bombay High Court has released the list of candidates shortlisted for the Physical Fitness and Special Skill Test for the post of Peon/Hamal/Farash. A total of 5,517 candidates have been shortlisted for the Principal Seat at Bombay, while 1,378 candidates have been shortlisted for the Nagpur Bench. The shortlist has been prepared based on the cut-off marks in the Screening/Written Test.

Establishment Candidates Shortlisted
Principal Seat at Bombay 5,517
Bench at Nagpur 1,378

Bombay High Court Result 2026 Out

The Bombay High Court Result released on 1st September 2026 for both Clerk & Peon posts officially. Candidates who appeared in the exam can now check the selection list through the PDF of results available online. The result has the names & roll numbers of shortlisted candidates who have qualified for the next stage. The declaration of the Bombay High Court Result marks a step in the process of recruitment. It helps candidates assess the performance so that they have got a position in the Bombay High Court merit list. Those who qualify must prepare for procedures like document verification or interview depending on the post applied for.

Bombay High Court Peon and Clerk Results 2026: Overview

The recruitment for Bombay High Court Clerk & Peon positions involves multiple stages & staying updated with the official timeline is important for every applicant. The following table gives a summary of the recruitment like the status of the Clerk & Bombay High Court Peon Result 2026 & other statistics.

Result Status Released

Bombay High Court Results 2026 PDF Download Link

The Bombay High Court 2026 Result is available in PDF form on the official website. Candidates can access the result by going to the recruitment section. The PDF contains the Bombay High Court merit list like roll numbers or names of selected candidates. For accuracy candidates should check the details in the result file. It is advisable to download & save the PDF for future reference for the next stages of recruitment especially. The Bombay High Court Result PDF is an official document confirming qualification status.

Steps to Check Bombay High Court 2026 Result

To check the Bombay High Court 2026 Result candidates must visit the official website & go to the recruitment tab made for District Court updates. The process is made to give access to the merit lists without technical problems. See that the candidates have a stable internet connection & the roll number before starting the process. Follow the detailed steps provided as under to access the Clerk & Bombay High Court Peon Result :

  1. Visit Official Site: Go to the official Bombay High Court website which is bombayhighcourt.nic.in.
  2. Navigate to Recruitment: Click on the ‘Recruitment’ tab located on the left side or top header of the homepage
  3. Select the Link: Look for the link named “Clerk & Bombay High Court Peon Result.”
  4. Open PDF: Click on the link to open the result PDF in the browser.
  5. Search Details: Use the ‘Ctrl+F’ function to type in the roll number or name.
  6. Verify Status: If the candidate’s number is showcased they have cleared the exam
  7. Save/Print: Download the file & print a copy for the personal records.

Details Mentioned on the Bombay High Court Results PDF

The Bombay High Court Results PDF contains important information that identifies the candidate & confirms the performance in the recruitment cycle. It is more than just a list of names & is a structured document so that there is transparency in the selection process. Candidates should verify every detail mentioned against the name to see that there are no clerical errors. If any discrepancy is found it must be reported to the office of registrar immediately.

  • Candidate Name: The full name of the applicant as registered during the application
  • Roll Number: The unique identification number assigned for the exam
  • Registration ID: The ID generated at the time of form submission.
  • Category: The social category (General, SC, ST, OBC, etc.) under which the candidate applied
  • Marks Obtained: The total score achieved in the written/screening test
  • Qualifying Status: A clear indication of whether the candidate is “Shortlisted” for the next phase.
  • Instructions: Guidelines regarding the date & venue for the upcoming typing or cleaning test.

Bombay High Court Peon Cut Off Marks 2026

The Bombay High Court has fixed different cut-off marks for the Screening/Written Test for the Peon/Hamal/Farash post. Candidates who scored equal to or more than the required cut-off marks have been shortlisted for the Physical Fitness and Special Skill Test. The cut-off was fixed by applying the shortlisting criteria based on the number of posts advertised

Establishment Cut-Off Marks
Principal Seat at Bombay 24 marks
Bench at Nagpur 25 marks

Bombay High Court 2026 Score Card

The Bombay High Court scorecard is a personalized document that gives a breakdown of the marks obtained by a candidate in each section of the exam. Unlike the merit list which is a public PDF the scorecard requires a login via the application ID & password of the candidate. It permits the candidates to analyze the performance & see exactly where one stands in terms of accuracy & speed. Having the Bombay High Court scorecard is helpful for candidates who did not make it to the merit list as it helps identify areas for improvement in exams. For successful candidates the scorecard acts as a proof of the academic merit during the final interview stage. See that the candidates download & print the document as soon as the link is activated as it may not be available indefinitely on the server.

What Next After Bombay High Court Result 2026

After the release of the Bombay High Court Result 2026 shortlisted candidates must prepare for the evaluation rounds. For those who applied for the Clerk position the next stage is the English & Marathi typing test where speed & accuracy are tested. For Peon/Hamal candidates the next phase involves a cleaning & versatility test followed by a personal interview. The rounds are important as they carry weightage in the final selection of the candidates.

  1. Typing Test (Clerks): Practice daily to maintain a speed of at least 40 words per minute
  2. Cleaning/Viva-Voce (Peons): Understand the duties of a Bombay High Court peon & prepare for general awareness questions.
  3. Document Verification: Gather original copies of the educational certificates, caste certificates & ID proofs.
  4. Final Interview: Work on the communication skills & knowledge of the Maharashtra judicial system.
  5. Medical Examination: A basic fitness check to see that candidates are capable of performing the duties.

If you have any doubts regarding the exam feel free to contact us. Candidates can also download our free learning Testbook App to prepare for any government exam in the best way.

Bombay High Court Result 2026 FAQs

Question: Is Bombay High Court 2026 Result Released?

Answer: Yes the Bombay High Court Peon Result 2026 released on September 1. Candidates can access the result on the recruitment page of the official website.

Question: How to check Bombay High Court result 2026 from the official website?

Answer: The direct link to result is given in this page. You can also visit bombayhighcourt.nic.in & click on the ‘Recruitment’ section, find the link for the 2026 Clerk/Peon result & download the PDF file to search for the roll number.

Question: What is the importance of the Bombay High Court merit list?

Answer: The Bombay High Court merit list tells which candidate is eligible for next stage typing tests & interviews based on the high scores in the screening exam.

Question: What is the cut-off for the Bombay High Court Peon/Hamal/Farash exam?

Answer: The cut-off is 24 marks for the Bombay Principal Seat and 25 marks for the Nagpur Bench.

Question: What happens after the Bombay High Court Peon Result?

Answer: Candidates who are shortlisted will have to appear for the Physical Fitness and Special Skill Test. The date, time and place will be shared later on the official website.
